About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are looking for a motivated Security Infrastructure Engineer Intern to join our team and gain hands-on experience securing cloud infrastructure, applications, and developer workflows.

In this role, you will work on real-world security problems across AWS and Kubernetes environments, with exposure to vulnerability management, detection systems, and infrastructure security controls. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers to investigate issues, improve security visibility, and help build foundational security capabilities.

This is a balanced role that combines hands-on work - such as analyzing findings and reviewing logs - with learning and exploratory work, including understanding how security systems are designed and improved over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Assist with vulnerability management activities, including reviewing scan results and helping validate findings
  • Support triage of security findings from internal tools and external sources
  • Help analyze logs and alerts from SIEM systems to identify potential security issues
  • Participate in basic security incident investigations and documentation
  • Assist in implementing and improving security controls across AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure
  • Support efforts to improve detection capabilities and monitoring coverage
  • Learn and contribute to securing CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure workflows
  • Work with engineering teams to understand and help address security issues

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Cybersecurity, or a related field
  • Basic understanding of computer systems, networking, and security fundamentals
  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line tools
  • Interest in cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and infrastructure systems
  • Basic knowledge of common security concepts (e.g., vulnerabilities, authentication, OWASP Top 10)
  • Exposure to programming or scripting (Python, Go, or Bash)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Eagerness to learn and take ownership of tasks
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Familiarity with containers (Docker) and basic Kubernetes concepts
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, or SIEM tools
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines
  • Interest in areas like cloud security, infrastructure security, or detection engineering

About You:

  • You are curious and eager to learn new technologies and systems.
  • You take initiative and are excited to solve problems, even if you don’t have all the answers yet.
  • You are detail-oriented and care about building reliable systems.
  • You collaborate well with others and are open to feedback.
  • You are adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. 

Compensation: The salary for the Security Infrastructure Engineer Intern is $2.800.000 COP monthly.
